title: run controlled local update execute-or-deny evidence

criteria: Controlled local update either executes against the exact repo-local target or denies before effect with non-fabricated audit evidence.
Update execution is impossible unless exact target, exact approval, executable AgentCore PlanSpec, SecurityExecution allow, rollback preconditions, and install/update ordering evidence are bound.
No remote payload download, host active slot mutation, host boot metadata mutation, production ring mutation, support upload, recovery execution, or remote dispatch occurs.
